verdict.rationale: Riveter is a hosted data-enrichment API service, so a public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, or postmortems. The SDK retry handling and webhooks are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
